output.reason: The collective labour agreement sets company payroll rules that change PPh 21 inputs for permanent employees: JP contributions (2% company, 1% employee) and health insurance contributions (4% company, 1% employee) are computed on the full monthly wage without a wage cap, which changes the employer health portion added to gross income and the employee JP deduction; it fixes the JKK rate at 1.27% (high-risk group) and JKM at 0.30% borne by the company, which enter gross income; it sets JHT at 3.7% company and 2% employee (employee part deductible); it states that monthly PPh 21 uses the monthly effective rate on gross income including employer JKK, JKM and health contributions; and for employees leaving before December it keeps the monthly effective rate in the last month instead of an annual recalculation, leaving the difference to the employee's annual return. Validity 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2026.

quotes.quote: Bagi pekerja yang berhenti bekerja sebelum bulan Desember, Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 21 pada bulan terakhir bekerja dihitung dengan tarif efektif bulanan sebagaimana bulan-bulan sebelumnya, dan kekurangan atau kelebihan Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 21 diselesaikan sendiri oleh pekerja dalam Surat Pemberitahuan Tahunan.
